assets.text: In a green meadow at the edge of the woods, there lived a hare. He was quick, he was clever, and he was very, very proud.
assets.style: Warm, gentle, expressive children’s picture-book narrator in the classic bedtime film style, unhurried and clear

assets.text: Every morning he raced the wind across the grass. "Nobody in the whole wide world," he boasted, "is as fast as me!"
assets.style: Warm, gentle, expressive children’s picture-book narrator in the classic bedtime film style, unhurried and clear

assets.text: One day, the hare met a tortoise plodding slowly along the path. "Ha!" he laughed. "You are so slow, you will never get anywhere at all!"
assets.style: Warm, gentle, expressive children’s picture-book narrator in the classic bedtime film style, unhurried and clear

assets.text: The tortoise blinked her old, wise eyes. "Slow I may be," she said, "but I will race you, if you like."
assets.style: Warm, gentle, expressive children’s picture-book narrator in the classic bedtime film style, unhurried and clear

assets.text: News of the race spread through the woods. All the animals came to watch, and the fox waved the flag: ready, steady, go!
assets.style: Warm, gentle, expressive children’s picture-book narrator in the classic bedtime film style, unhurried and clear

assets.text: Whoosh! Off shot the hare, so fast that the flowers bent over in the wind. And off went the tortoise too: step, step, step.
assets.style: Warm, gentle, expressive children’s picture-book narrator in the classic bedtime film style, unhurried and clear

assets.text: Soon the hare was far, far ahead. He looked back, and he could not even see the tortoise. "I have plenty of time," he yawned. "I think I'll take a little nap."
assets.style: Warm, gentle, expressive children’s picture-book narrator in the classic bedtime film style, unhurried and clear

assets.text: The sun climbed high into the sky. The hare snored, and dreamed of winning. But the tortoise kept on walking: step, step, step.
assets.style: Warm, gentle, expressive children’s picture-book narrator in the classic bedtime film style, unhurried and clear

assets.text: Past the pond, up the hill, and right past the sleeping hare she went. Step, step, step.

assets.text: When at last the hare woke up, the sun was going down. He leapt to his feet and ran as fast as he could!

assets.text: But it was too late. The tortoise was already crossing the finish line, and all the animals cheered and cheered.
assets.style: Warm, gentle, expressive children’s picture-book narrator in the classic bedtime film style, unhurried and clear

assets.text: The hare hung his head. And the tortoise smiled a slow, kind smile. "Slow and steady," she said, "wins the race."
